checks.describe: mypy's reveal_type() shows the union type narrowing to a specific member inside an isinstance branch
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m13dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m13dd/narrowing_demo.py
from pathlib import Path

from platformops.config import load_service_yaml
from platformops.servicedef import ServiceDefinition


def report(path: Path) -> str:
    result = load_service_yaml(path)
    reveal_type(result)

    if isinstance(result, ServiceDefinition):
        reveal_type(result)
        return result.to_summary()

    reveal_type(result)
    return f\"{len(result)} error(s)\"
PYEOF
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.1 && uv run mypy /tmp/m13dd/narrowing_demo.py ; true"
